paite: Huchi in tempul kongkhak ah ahon pikik a; ngai dih, tempul kongpi chin nuai a kipan, suahlam nga in tui ahong luangkhia a; tempul suahlam nga ahi a, huan tui maitam simlam tempul pang taklam nuai a kipan in ahong luangkhia hi.
heading: Tempul A Kipan Lui Hong Luangkhia
english: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.

paite: Huan mallam nga kongpi tawn in ahon pikhia a, inpua ah suahlam nga pawtkhiakna lampi ponungzaw tawn in ahon pi a; ngai dih, taklam pang ah tui ahong luangkhia hi.
english: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

paite: Huan huai mi'n tehna khau tawi kawm a suahlam nga a pai in tong sangkhat ateh a; tui ahon ngap galkahsak a, siakmit tan ahi.
english: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.

paite: Huchi in tong sangkhat ateh nawn a; tui ahon ngap galkahsak nawn a, khuk tan ahi. Huan tong sangkhat ateh nawn a; hon ngap galkahsak nawn a, tui kawng tan ahi.
english: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.

paite: Huan tong sangkhat ateh nawn a; ngah galkah vual louh luipi ahong hita a; tui ahong sang zel a, angah a ngah galkah vual louh, aleuh a leuh tham luipi ahong hita hi.
english: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.

paite: Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiai na mu hia?" achi hi. Huan lui gei a kik nawn ding in ahon pikikta hi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river.

paite: Huchi in ka kik a, ngai dih, lui gei tawn in, lui gei lang tuak in sing tampi ana om hi.
english: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai suahlam gam lam a tui luang Arabah gam a luanglut ding ahi; tuipi ah aluanglut ding a, tuipi tui al tui siangthou asuaksak ding.
english: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a; luite aluanna peuh uah ganhing chiteng in ahinloh ding ua, ngasate a-om huthut ding uh; tuipi tui asianthouna ding leh aluanna peuh a ganhingte'n ahinlohna ding ua hiai lui hong luang ahi.
english: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a; agei ah ngaman mite adingh ding ua; Engedi a kipan Eneglaim pha in lenpaihna mun ahi ding; angasa pen achi bang zel un, tuipi lian ngasa bang mai in atam mahmah ding uh.
english: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

paite: Buannawi leh chiklakte bel asiangthou kei ding ua, chikhuk ding a nutsiat ahi ding hi.
english: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

paite: Alui gei ah agei langnih in theikung chi chih apou ding a, huaite anah avuai ngei kei in agah lou ngei sam kei ding, mun siangthou a kipan a lui hong luangkhia a vak ahih ziak in kha teng in agah ding; agah nek ding ahi ding a, anah bel hihdamna ding ahi ding," achi hi.
english: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Hiai Israel nam sawm-le-nih lak a gam kihawmdan ding ahi hi; Joseph in tan nih atang ding.
heading: Gam Gamgite
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

paite: Kibang chiat in na tang ding uh ahi; na pipute uh kiang a piak ding a ka kichiamsa ahi; hiai gam na gam tan un apuk ding ahi.
english: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.

paite: Hiai a gam pumpi gi ding ahi; mallam ah Tuipi Lian a kipan Hethlon a paisuak in Hamath lutna phaizang ah Zedad atung a;
english: “This shall be the border of the land: “On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;

paite: Berothah, Damaskas leh Hamath kigitna lai a om Sibraim, Hauran gamgi zul a om Hazor-hattikon pha in.
english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

paite: Huchi in gamgi bel Tuipi Lian a kipan in Damaskas gamgi zul a Hazar-enan pha in ahi ding a; mallam ah Hamath gamgi ahi ding hi. Hiai mallam gamgi ahi.
english: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

paite: Huan suahlam ah Hauran leh Damaskas kikal ah Gilead leh Israel gam kikal a Jordan luidung azui ding; mallam gamgi a kipan in suahlam tuipi ah Tamar apha ding. Hiai suahlam gamgi ahi ding hi.
english: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.

paite: Simlam ah Tamar a kipan in Meibothkadesh tuite pha in Aigupta lui zui in Tuipi Lian atung ding. Hiai simlam gamgi ding ahi.
english: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.

paite: Tumlam ah Tuipi Lian in agi ding a, simlam gamgi a kipan in Hamath lutna phaizang zawn pha in. Hiai tumlam gamgi ahi ding hi.
english: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.

paite: Huchi in hiai gam Israel nam dungzui in na lak uah na hawm ding uh.
english: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, na gam tan ding uleh na lak ua namdang teng, zi leh ta neisate gam tan ding bel na hop ding uh ahi. Amau lah Israel ta ding a piang mawng ahi ding uh ahi; Israel namte lak ah noute bang in tan aneih ding uh ahi.
english: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a; kua nam lak ah leng namdang ana teng taleh, huai lai a agam tan ding na sehsak ding uh ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord Yahweh.
